results.title: Share link selects verses
results.checks: ?v=16-18 opens with John 3:16–18 selected and the verse toolbar's Highlight naming them

results.title: Highlight and clear
results.checks: Select 3:16, tap a colour → a ribbon appears; select again → Clear highlight → gone

results.title: Share a verse: link and embed code
results.checks: Select 3:16 → Share opens the Share dialog; Copy link copies a link ending in ?v=16; the embed code is an iframe of the compact reader, dark when Dark is chosen

results.title: Save a verse range
results.checks: Select 3:15–16 → Save in the verse toolbar; Your Content lists John 3:15–16

results.title: The phone's verse sheet
results.checks: On an iPhone 13, tapping John 3:3 brings up the old reader's sheet along the bottom in place of the tabs: a handle, ✕, 'John 3:3' and four cards Highlight · Save · Note · Copy, with 'Swipe up to see more'. A tap on the handle shows Share and Compare; a swipe down closes the sheet and the tabs come back. Highlight turns it into the colour strip with ← and the eraser; a colour highlights the verse and closes the sheet
results.note: cards Highlight · Save · Note · Copy in place of the tabs; the handle showed Share and Compare; a swipe down closed it; Highlight → the strip with ← and the eraser; a colour highlighted 3:3

results.title: The old reader's bottom bar; every action within reach
results.checks: On a desktop the bar is ‹ Books · Search · Discover · the extensions · More ›, each with its word under the icon; Books opens the book picker and Search opens the floating search box, ready to type in; More lists Sign in, Live session, Today, Notes, Library, Your content, Full screen and Themes. On a phone every one of those actions is in its five tabs (Today · You · Bible · Search · More) or the More sheet
results.note: desktop bar: Books · Search · Discover · Places map · Study companion · More; under More: login Sign in, group_add Live session, today Today, sticky_note_2 Notes, queue_music Library, library_books Your content, fullscreen Full screen, dark_mode Themes; Books and Search open; on a phone all 9 actions reachable

results.title: Clearing or re-colouring part of a highlight keeps the rest
results.checks: Highlight John 3:14–17 yellow; clear verse 15: 14, 16 and 17 stay yellow; colour 16 green: 17 stays yellow; clear them all
results.note: 14–17 yellow; clearing 15 kept 14, 16, 17; colouring 16 green kept 17 yellow; cleared

results.title: A phone: the old reader's phone shell
results.checks: On an iPhone 13: a thin bar at the top (the translation, then ☆, bookmark, share and text settings), the chapter's title centred and large (John over a big 3), and along the bottom play and the chapter pill ‹ John 3 › above the five tabs Today · You · Bible · Search · More, with Bible lit. The pill's › goes to John 4 and its label opens the book picker; Bible on the text opens it too. More → Tabs opens the Tabs drawer, which closes with its ✕ and with a tap beside it; reading down scrolls the page itself; signed out, You carries the count of changes waiting and opens the sign-in pane
results.note: top bar: 5 buttons; title "John 3"; tabs Today · You · Bible · Search · More; › and the pill and Bible worked; the Tabs drawer closed by ✕ and by a tap beside it; the page scrolled; You carried the waiting count and opened sign-in
